{"design":"## State, 2026-11-26

Done, in mimi-mls:
- SemiPrivateMessage::unseal_keys: the entry lookup, the HPKE context,
  DecryptWithLabel, and the partial_context_hash check.
- framed_content_tbs / check_framed_content_tbs: the FramedContentTBS an
  external receiver rebuilds, with the semiprivate wire format of
  decision mimid-1wgh.4.79.9 and the sender leaf from the sealed keys.
- decode_parts and ContentSpans: the received spans of the content and
  of the signature, because the hash and the signature cover the bytes
  as they arrived and re-encoding a decoded ProposalIn need not
  reproduce them.
- label::aead_open and label::hash.
- open_as_external_receiver: the whole of §3.3 in order.

Done, in mimid-server:
- The hub HPKE pair in hub_secret (migration 0024), one per hub.
- check_external_receivers in check_group: the component, if present,
  names the hub and nobody else.
- Hub::external_receiver_ref, Hub::unseal_semiprivate.

Not done, and why:
- No end-to-end test with a real sender yet. Each piece has its own
  test, but nothing in mimid BUILDS a SemiPrivateMessage (that is bead
  mimid-1wgh.4.79.3), so the AEAD open, the two hashes and the signature
  have not been shown to agree on their inputs. A disagreement between
  them would pass every test written so far. A test that stands in for
  the sender is the next thing to write; it needs label::aead_seal.
- The hub does not yet call open_as_external_receiver from its message
  intake. It needs the sender leaf's signature key out of the ratchet
  tree at the index the sealed keys name, which the Observer has."}
